question: Why did the frozen I029 metadata-matched K=3 donor rule fail its preregistered primary gap-direction support threshold despite favorable medians: donor-pool instability, within-donor instability, mean/concentration residual misalignment, or condition-specific transfer heterogeneity?

frozen_i029_donor_rule.ordering: lexicographically minimize [scenario_group_mismatch, reverb_mismatch, snr_missing_penalty, absolute_snr_distance, exact_scenario_mismatch, case_key]

joint_reference_semantics.first_ready_reference: the first eight ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames after warmup, preserved as ordered joint tuples of mirror_mean, mirror_concentration and mirror_gap
joint_reference_semantics.donor_case_summary: component-wise medians across the eight joint frames
joint_reference_semantics.selected_donor_aggregate: component-wise median across the frozen K=3 donor-case summaries
joint_reference_semantics.target_reference_role: retrospective benchmark only; never a causal input for earlier target frames

decomposition_metrics.within_donor_dispersion: per selected donor case, component MAD across its eight joint frames; aggregate by median across K=3 donors
decomposition_metrics.between_donor_dispersion: component MAD across the K=3 donor-case medians
decomposition_metrics.target_dispersion: component MAD across the target benchmark's eight joint frames
decomposition_metrics.joint_l1_dispersion: median per-frame L1 deviation from each case's joint median
decomposition_metrics.component_implied_gap_residual: concentration signed residual minus mean signed residual
decomposition_metrics.gap_alignment_error: absolute difference between observed gap signed residual and component-implied gap residual
decomposition_metrics.gap_axis_fraction: absolute gap-axis projection divided by absolute gap-axis plus absolute common-mode projection
decomposition_metrics.gap_outcome_partition: frozen I029 continuity measure: negative-control absolute gap error minus matched-donor absolute gap error; positive=matched better, negative=matched worse

preregistered_slices.primary_population: target cases with at least one pre-ready oracle-speech disagreement target under the unchanged eight-reference observation boundary
preregistered_slices.note: All slices are descriptive decomposition only. No slice may select a donor/reference candidate or replace I029's failed primary endpoint.

diagnostic_outputs: all selected donor and target first-ready references with eight joint mean/concentration/gap tuples
within-donor, between-donor and target MAD decomposition

decision_contract.NS_UPSTREAM_DONOR_JOINT_RESIDUAL_STABILI: Fresh donor/target authority, frozen I029 donor rule, exact eight-frame joint references, coverage and shipping mirrors are valid. Report stability/residual decomposition for review without redesigning donor matching or selecting a reference source.
decision_contract.I030_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, frozen-input identity, donor/target disjointness, donor/benchmark coverage, joint-frame preservation, named-slice population or shipping mirror preconditions fail.

next_review: Use I030 only to attribute I029 transfer instability. Any donor-rule redesign, reference-source candidate, component counterfactual, mapping or shipping change requires a new independently preregistered authority.
